specialist_latest_commit.message: worker-c: Deterministic handling of same-clock conflicting same-record revisions

candidate.name: Metaplanet October 5 2026 Bitcoin sale-and-reacquisition disclosure
candidate.index_title: Notice of Additional Purchase of Bitcoin (Including Sale and Reacquisition of Bitcoin to Demonstrate Liquidity)

criteria.first_party_machine_readable: PARTIAL: first-party HTML disclosure index is accessible, but accession-specific report PDF/HTML numeric payload was not recovered and parsed
criteria.immutable_event_report_block_identity: FAIL: no verified immutable primary report URL/hash/document identity; index listing is mutable
criteria.economic_entity_scope: PARTIAL: Metaplanet group identified, but sale/reacquisition and possible subsidiaries/financing arrangements not reconciled from primary
criteria.effective_clock: PARTIAL: index date 2026-10-05; trade-by-trade effective timestamps not verified
criteria.available_clock: PARTIAL: dated disclosure index only; exact first-publication timestamp and revisions unverified
criteria.non_overlap: FAIL: reported 10k sale and 11k reacquisition are a round-trip, not independent 21k net purchasing capital; exchange-volume and existing treasury overlap not excluded
criteria.context_only: REQUIRED: reported 44k BTC quarter-end treasury stock must never be directional scored

candidate.rejection: Official Metaplanet disclosure index verifies a dated notice about BTC sale and reacquisition, but no accessible immutable first-party numeric report was verified in this audit. Secondary reports of 10,000 BTC sold and 11,000 reacquired cannot be promoted as first-party parsed evidence. Even if confirmed, gross legs cannot be added as independent capital flows; 44,000 BTC end-of-quarter treasury inventory is context-only. Exact trade identities/timestamps, publication revision clock, and non-overlap are unproven.

promotion: NONE; C CONTINUE and independent validation absent
